ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels concentrated on the lateral lobes and 60% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central and leading edge regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields occupy the outer two-thirds of both lobes; left lobe white field contains irregular black mottling near the lower boundary; right lobe white field is bisected by three distinct, parallel vertical black linear features; central region near the notch is solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a measured pixel angle of approximately 60 degrees and a depth reaching roughly 15% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing boundary; high-frequency peaks and valleys are most pronounced on the distal edges of the lobes; localized pixel interference from trailing water droplets is present.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate concavity observed along the trailing edges of both lobes, curving upwards toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of high-intensity white pixels at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, exhibiting a circular, textured morphology.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three prominent, near-vertical parallel dark lines on the white field of the right lobe; several smaller, less-aligned linear disruptions on the lower portion of the left lobe's white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent triple rake-mark scarring on the right lobe; minor irregular indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe approximately mid-way between the notch and the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific geometric arrangement of the three parallel vertical marks on the right lobe provides a unique spatial identifier.
